adjudication.disclosure: This is an AI-assisted semantic adjudication, not human review. A human spot-check is optional and must not be claimed unless performed.
adjudication.method: Each flagged claim was compared with the frozen evidence blocks named by its citation IDs. Whole-claim support and citation attribution were checked separately. For v5, adjudication evaluated the preserved first structurally valid response and did not repair or reject its content.
